purpose: Albedo studies for cave materials. These are not complete PBR texture sets. Seamless tiling was requested and still needs in-engine inspection.
limestone_albedo_v2.png: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square tileable BASE COLOR / ALBEDO texture for a realistic natural limestone cave in a 3D game. Create ONE flat orthographic texture, filling the entire square image edge to edge. Weathered gray beige limestone with irregular broken sedimentary bedding, broad eroded shelves, rough angular fractures, small calcite veins and subtle ochre mineral staining. Medium scale, covering approximately 3 by 3 meters. Complex real natural stone, not bricks, not a pattern of identical stones. Neutral diffuse reflectance colors with no directional illumination, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion darkening, no highlights, no perspective, no vignette, no borders, no text. Edges should tile seamlessly in both axes. Geological layering irregular and slightly tilted, with broad forms and fine grain. No moss, grass, water or snow. NOT a scene, NOT a rendered cave, NOT a material ball. Only the texture surface, uniform exposure. 2048x2048 square.
damp_rock_albedo_v2.png: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square tileable BASE COLOR / ALBEDO texture for damp cave rock in a realistic 3D game. ONE flat orthographic square texture, edge to edge. Fractured dark warm-gray limestone with scattered mineral veins, weathered irregular plates, scattered brown-gray damp stains and occasional pale calcite mottling. Darker than dry limestone but preserve legible midtones rather than black. Natural subterranean geology, varied medium and small scale features, approximately 3 by 3 meters of rock. Flat diffuse-only neutral illumination. No specular glints or water reflections, no cast shadows, no directional lighting, no baked AO, no vignette, no perspective, no borders, no text. Seamless tiling in both directions. No plants, moss, snow, bricks, crystals or sci-fi details. Not a cave scene and not a material sphere. Only the photographic surface texture. 2048x2048 square.
scree_floor_albedo_v2.png: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square tileable BASE COLOR / ALBEDO texture for a realistic dry cave floor in a 3D game. ONE flat orthographic top-down square texture, filling the image edge to edge. Natural gray beige limestone scree and compacted dark brown-gray mineral earth: thin irregular broken rock chips, small angular gravel, fine grit, occasional palm-sized flat stone fragments embedded in sediment. Believable sparse distribution with open packed earth between clusters, not a uniform pebbled carpet. Approximately 2 by 2 meters of ground. Neutral flat diffuse illumination, color only, no cast shadows, no baked ambient occlusion, no highlights, no perspective, no vignette, no borders, no labels or text. Seamless tiling on both axes. No vegetation, footsteps, trash, snow, puddles or bones. NOT a landscape, NOT a rendered cave, NOT a material sphere. Only the flat photographic texture. 2048x2048 square.
